exact_card_426.limits: ZIP CRC and raw XML counts/uniqueness were audited; deterministic card tests and snapshots do not establish whole-pilot competence, initialized execution, semantic replay, or Stage-E gameplay. current_source_gap.historical: Original A–D machine-readable bytes remain missing. Historical reported outcomes are attribution-limited; this prospective pilot work does not replace or rerun A–D.

proposed_equal_competence_scope.rule: Freeze an exact, finite fixture inventory and the source head before the first new fixture execution. Give all four identities the same predeclared total opportunity and the same common checks, plus identity-specific legal-card cases within equal reserved budgets. Preserve every executed failure and correction. Equal case counts alone do not establish competence; all reachable decision kinds and card-specific branches must pass for every identity.

bank_geometry_for_review_only.change_rule: Before any execution, publish the complete numbered 256-case bank and independently review whether every reachable path fits. If it does not, revise this proposal prospectively before exposure. Never add cases after viewing deck outcomes to favor one identity.
